name: web-info-badge-pill-with-inner-tag-and-arrow-in-sky-blue
title: Pale blue pill badge 'Info | Welcome to the platform ↗' with a lighter inner tag and a diagonal arrow
whatItIs: A single sky-blue capsule with a subtle border and soft shadow: an inner lighter pill 'Info', the message 'Welcome to the platform' and a small diagonal arrow, all in mid-blue text.
whatItMeans: Gentle and informative; tonal blues make a notice feel calm.
techniques: Nest a lighter tag inside a tinted capsule.
Colour text and border from the same hue.

vocabulary.definition: A capsule with a short message and arrow.
A lighter label nested in a pill.
Text, fill and border from one hue.
An arrow pointing up and right to indicate a link.
